info.name: VALUM API — Tasks | Grupo 3 (CORREGIDA)
info.description: Independent local API acceptance suite for VALUM Group 3. CORRECTED edition: unique g3_ variable namespace prevents collisions with existing Postman environments and Group 2; each successful create captures its ID BEFORE secondary assertions; nonexistent task ID is never reused for a created task. 57 HTTP requests in strict order. Requires full Collection Runner with no parallel execution. Defaults to http://localhost:4596; local isolated SQLite DB only. Fresh project created on each run; no seed. Group 4 archive RN-01 HTTP acceptance is deferred until the archive endpoint exists. For restart persistence, manually resend final GET with same SQLite DB after restarting API. If a request fails, inspect the FIRST failed response before cascading assertions.

item.name: 00 — Preparación
item.description: Run this folder first. It creates a new dedicated project in the isolated database.

request.description: Starts a fresh run. Requires VALUM API running against a dedicated disposable SQLite DB; never point this collection at production.
Creates a NEW project each Runner execution; no hardcoded seeded identifiers.

item.name: 02 — Datos y UTC
item.description: Creates four more tasks in the same project. Tests precise timezone conversion, nullable/missing dates and status filters.

request.description: This covers the unproven equivalence test: TWO DIFFERENT input representations of the same instant.

exec: pm.test("Same instant in +02:00 is exactly equal to Z",function(){

pm.test("HTTP 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });pm.test("Offset-twin retrieved UTC ticks-equivalent representation",function(){const t=pm.response.json();pm.expect(t.dueDate).to.eql("2026-12-31T23:59:59.1234567Z");pm.expect(t.priority).to.eql(2);});

pm.test("HTTP 201", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });pm.test("Negative offset crosses UTC year correctly",function(){const t=pm.response.json();pm.expect(t.dueDate).to.eql("2027-01-01T05:29:59Z");pm.expect(t.priority).to.eql(0);});

pm.test("HTTP 201", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });pm.test("Explicit null is persisted as null",function(){const t=pm.response.json();pm.expect(t.dueDate).to.be.null;pm.expect(t.priority).to.eql(2);});

pm.test("HTTP 201", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });pm.test("Missing DueDate is null",function(){const t=pm.response.json();pm.expect(t.dueDate).to.be.null;pm.expect(t.priority).to.eql(0);});

item.name: 03 — Listados y RN-05
item.description: Filters by status/priority, DB pagination, stable page traversal, project summary counts.

exec: pm.test("PagedResult structure, defaults and task count",function(){

pm.test("HTTP 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });pm.test("High priority exactly two",function(){const p=pm.response.json();pm.expect(p.totalCount).to.eql(2);pm.expect(p.items).to.have.length(2);p.items.forEach(t=>pm.expect(t.priority).to.eql(2));});

pm.test("HTTP 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });pm.test("Only active in-progress task returned",function(){const p=pm.response.json();pm.expect(p.totalCount).to.eql(1);pm.expect(p.items[0].id.toLowerCase()).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("g3_nullTaskId").toLowerCase());pm.expect(p.items[0].status).to.eql(1);});

pm.test("HTTP 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });pm.test("Combined filters narrow result correctly",function(){const p=pm.response.json();pm.expect(p.totalCount).to.eql(1);pm.expect(p.items[0].id.toLowerCase()).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("g3_twinTaskId").toLowerCase());pm.expect(p.items[0].status).to.eql(0);pm.expect(p.items[0].priority).to.eql(2);});

pm.test("HTTP 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });pm.test("Pagination second page, no overlap",function(){const p=pm.response.json();const ids=p.items.map(t=>t.id);pm.expect(ids).to.have.length(2);pm.expect(p.totalPages).to.eql(3);pm.expect(p.hasPrevious).to.eql(true);pm.expect(p.hasNext).to.eql(true);JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get("g3_page1Ids")).forEach(id=>pm.expect(ids).not.to.include(id));pm.collectionVariables.set("g3_page2Ids",JSON.stringify(ids));});

pm.test("HTTP 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });pm.test("All pages yield 5 different task IDs",function(){const p=pm.response.json();pm.expect(p.items).to.have.length(1);pm.expect(p.hasPrevious).to.eql(true);pm.expect(p.hasNext).to.eql(false);const ids=[...JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get("g3_page1Ids")),...JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get("g3_page2Ids")),...p.items.map(t=>t.id)];pm.expect(new Set(ids.map(s=>s.toLowerCase())).size).to.eql(5);});

pm.test("HTTP 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });pm.test("RN-05 summary reflects active task statuses",function(){const r=pm.response.json();pm.expect(r.project.id.toLowerCase()).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("g3_projectId").toLowerCase());pm.expect(r.summary.totalTasks).to.eql(5);pm.expect(r.summary.completedTasks).to.eql(0);pm.expect(r.summary.inProgressTasks).to.eql(1);pm.expect(r.summary.pendingTasks).to.eql(4);});

item.name: 04 — Validaciones HTTP
item.description: Negative cases return VALUM standardized JSON error schema and do not persist invalid tasks.

item.name: 48 — Verify invalid requests added zero tasks

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });pm.test("Rejected commands did not create rows",function(){const p=pm.response.json();pm.expect(p.totalCount).to.eql(5);pm.expect(p.items).to.have.length(5);});

item.name: 05 — Soft-delete y persistencia
item.description: DELETE/DELETE/GET/PATCH/list/summary regression. The final request can also be resent manually AFTER API restart.

request.description: Different HTTP request/DI scope. Together with database integration tests, covers idempotence.

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });pm.test("Soft-deleted task hidden; 4 remain",function(){const p=pm.response.json();pm.expect(p.totalCount).to.eql(4);pm.expect(p.items).to.have.length(4);pm.expect(p.items.map(t=>t.id.toLowerCase())).not.to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("g3_primaryTaskId").toLowerCase());});

pm.test("HTTP 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });pm.test("RN-05 summary excludes deleted task",function(){const s=pm.response.json().summary;pm.expect(s.totalTasks).to.eql(4);pm.expect(s.completedTasks).to.eql(0);pm.expect(s.inProgressTasks).to.eql(1);pm.expect(s.pendingTasks).to.eql(3);});

item.name: 56 — GET twin for restart persistence check

request.description: After a successful Runner execution: STOP the API, START it again with the SAME dedicated valum_postman_test.db, then SEND THIS REQUEST MANUALLY to verify persistence across process restart.

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });pm.test("Task survives distinct requests with exact UTC value",function(){const t=pm.response.json();pm.expect(t.id.toLowerCase()).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("g3_twinTaskId").toLowerCase());pm.expect(t.dueDate).to.eql("2026-12-31T23:59:59.1234567Z");pm.expect(t.status).to.eql(0);});
